key_risks: Market Price Fluctuation: Real estate sales realizations subject to local demand-supply dynamics, economic growth, interest rates, and competitor actions.
Sales Volume Variability: Volume of property sales depends on project design, approvals, consumer sentiment, housing finance availability, and buyer trust.
Execution and Delivery: Construction delays from labor shortages, raw material price spikes, utility connection issues, adverse weather, litigation on land titles, or local disturbances.
